q: Can I submit work when there isn’t an open call?
a: You can introduce yourself in the Burrito Bar on Discord. Exhibition submissions open around specific briefs. Check the open calls page or follow @BurritoDAO on X for announcements.

q: What kinds of art can I submit?
a: Each call has its own requirements. Past calls have included digital art, street photography, and graffiti themes. Check the brief for accepted formats and deadlines.

q: How can I contact Burrito about a submission?
a: Email contact@burritodao.com and include the name of the open call.
